D: The Turtles return to stop Shredder from making new mutants with the last of the ooze.
P: Bring out the doughnuts when the turtles try the antidote on Tokka and Rahzar.
S: Charred green chilli and avocado mashed with lime and coriander, warm corn chips. Glows a little.

Char 2 long green chillies over a gas flame or under the grill until blackened, peel, seed and chop. Mash 3 avocados with the juice of 2 limes and 1 tsp salt. Fold in the chilli, half a finely diced red onion and a handful of chopped coriander. Press cling wrap on the surface until serving so it stays green. Serve with 300g warm corn chips.
Split mini bagels, red sauce, bubbling mozzarella and pepperoni. Nobody stops at one.
Split 6 mini bagels. Spread each half with pizza sauce (150ml in total), top with 150g grated mozzarella and 80g pepperoni and grill for 5 minutes until bubbling.
Bitter greens, shaved parmesan, lemon and crisp garlic crumbs. TGRI found them growing by the leak.

Fry 60g fresh breadcrumbs in 2 tbsp olive oil with 1 crushed garlic clove until crisp. Whisk the juice of 1 lemon with 3 tbsp olive oil and salt. Toss 200g dandelion greens or rocket with the dressing, scatter 40g shaved parmesan and the crumbs.
M: Pepperoni, pineapple and jalapeño pizza, how Keno got in the door at April's.

Stretch 500g pizza dough thin on an oiled tray. Spread with 200ml pizza sauce, scatter 250g grated mozzarella, 100g pepperoni, 200g fresh pineapple in small pieces and 1 thinly sliced jalapeño. Bake at the oven's highest setting for 10 to 12 minutes until the edges char.
Beef and parmesan meatballs in red sauce, melted mozzarella in a toasted roll. Mikey found the old station.

Mix 500g beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs and 30g grated parmesan, roll into 16 balls and brown in olive oil. Add 400ml pizza sauce and simmer 15 minutes. Split 4 sub rolls, fill with the meatballs and sauce, lay on 200g sliced mozzarella and grill until melted.
W: Buttermilk doughnuts fried golden, dipped in a sharp lime glaze. The bait for Tokka and Rahzar.

Whisk 300g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp bicarb soda, 100g caster sugar and a pinch of salt. Beat in 200ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 40g melted butter to a soft dough. Pat out 1.5cm thick on a floured bench and cut 12 rings. Fry in 1L vegetable oil at 175C, 2 minutes a side, and drain. Mix 200g icing sugar with the zest and juice of 2 limes, dip the warm doughnuts and let the glaze set.
K: Ooze canister lime and kiwi slushie
Kiwifruit, lime and honey blitzed with ice and lemonade. A safe batch.
Peel and chop 4 kiwifruit. Blend with 60ml lime juice, 2 tbsp honey and 4 cups ice until slushy. Add 400ml cold lemonade and pulse twice. Pour into 4 glasses with a lime wheel and thick straws.
